name: YuE2 Cover
summary: A new version of an existing song: YuE2 follows the melody of the clip you upload and sings it again in the style you ask for.

source.notes: The user workflow converted with tools/ui2api.py (subgraph nodes keep the 33: prefix). SheetSage2 turns the uploaded clip into an ABC melody score, YuE2GenerateMusic runs in melody mode on that score, and the 32-step dpm_2 / sgm_uniform sampler is the template's.

inputs.label: Song to cover
inputs.help: The reference song; SheetSage2 reads its melody, so a clear, dry mix follows better.

inputs.label: Style
inputs.default: English, soulful jazz-pop, expressive male vocal, relaxed 88 BPM, Rhodes piano, upright bass
inputs.help: How the cover should sound; leave empty to keep the reference's own style.

inputs.label: Lyrics
inputs.help: Leave empty to sing the reference's words, or write new ones with [Verse] / [Chorus] tags.

inputs.label: Steps
inputs.help: The template runs 32; fewer steps are faster and rougher.

notes: SheetSage2 reads the melody of the uploaded song into an ABC score, and YuE2GenerateMusic sings a new version over it in the style you ask for; the reference's words are kept unless you write lyrics. Only the melody guides the model, so a very produced mix still follows, but a dry vocal or a piano line follows best. The weights are CC BY-NC 4.0: personal use only, no commercial output.
